data.message: Just finished calibrating distributor in electrical, heading to sort cargo in storage

I found Alice's body in electrical. My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical. I didn't see anyone else along the way except Frank, who left medbay heading to storage around tick 7 while I was in medbay. When I got to electrical, Alice was already dead — no killer in sight, so they must have left right before I arrived. Whoever was in electrical just before me is the prime suspect. I'll be listening carefully to everyone's routes.

I was on the west side the whole round. My route was upper engine -> oxygen -> back to upper engine, working on my engine task. I didn't see anyone the entire time — nobody passed through upper engine or oxygen while I was there. So I can't vouch for anyone, but I also wasn't anywhere near electrical.

Eve's story puts Frank going from medbay to storage, which is away from electrical, so that's something to verify. I want to hear from Charlie and Diana especially — where were they? Anyone unaccounted for near electrical or cafeteria is suspicious. Also Eve, can you confirm how long you were in medbay before heading to electrical? Frank should be able to corroborate seeing you there.

I went navigation -> security -> weapons this round, working my way around the east side. At tick 6, I saw Charlie in security, and he had just come from electrical. That's important — Eve found Alice's body in electrical, and Charlie was coming out of electrical right around the time of the kill.

I'm currently in weapons with Charlie right now, for what it's worth. But Charlie, you need to explain what you were doing in electrical before going to security. That puts you at the crime scene at a very suspicious time.

Frank still needs to account for himself too — Eve says he went medbay to storage, but we should hear it from him.

I need to clear this up because Diana's framing makes me look bad, but the facts actually point elsewhere.

My route was electrical -> security. Yes, I was in electrical early — from the start through about tick 4. But here's the critical part: **Frank was in electrical with me the entire time** — ticks 2, 3, and 4. Alice came into electrical from cafeteria at tick 3, so Alice, Frank, and I were all in electrical together at ticks 3 and 4. Then I left for security, where Diana saw me at tick 6.

So when I left electrical, Alice was still alive and **Frank was still there with her**. 

Now compare that to Eve's story: Eve says Frank left medbay heading to storage at tick 7 while she was in medbay. But I'm telling you Frank was in electrical at tick 4 — that's consistent with Frank leaving electrical (after killing Alice) and passing through medbay toward storage. Frank had the opportunity and was the last person with Alice.

But here's what's suspicious about Eve: Eve claims her route was storage -> medbay -> electrical, and that she only saw Frank in medbay. If Eve went storage -> medbay -> electrical, she'd arrive at electrical right after Frank left — which is exactly when she "found" the body. That's also consistent with Eve being the killer and framing Frank.

I'm most suspicious of **Frank** right now — he was alone with Alice last by my account. I want to hear Frank's story before voting.

Okay, I need to address this directly because Charlie is throwing me under the bus, but his own timeline actually has holes.

My route was medbay -> electrical -> medbay -> storage. Yes, I was in electrical early. Charlie is correct that he, Alice, and I were all in electrical together around ticks 3-4. But here's what Charlie is conveniently leaving out: **Charlie left electrical at tick 4, and I left right after him heading back to medbay.** Alice was still alive when I left electrical.

Then I went medbay -> storage, and Eve saw me in medbay at tick 7, which matches her story.

Now think about the timing carefully. If I had killed Alice, I would have had to do it at tick 4 or 5 — but Charlie was right there with us until tick 4. The kill happened after both Charlie and I left. So who entered electrical after us? That's the real question.

Eve says her route was storage -> medbay -> electrical, and she "found" the body. If Eve came into electrical right after I left, she'd be the one alone with Alice. And reporters are always suspect — Eve had every opportunity.

Charlie's accusation against me only works if I stayed in electrical with Alice after he left. I didn't. I left going back through medbay, which is exactly the route Eve confirms seeing me on.

I'm most suspicious of **Eve**. She's the one who found the body, her route puts her at the scene at the kill window, and she's deflecting onto me. I vote Eve.

Wait — I already spoke first. But I'll respond to what's been said since.

Frank, your story has a serious problem. You said your route was medbay -> electrical -> medbay -> storage. But I was in medbay before going to electrical, and I only saw you LEAVING medbay toward storage at tick 7. If you had come back through medbay from electrical before that, I should have seen you arrive — unless our timing just barely missed.

More importantly: Charlie says you were the last one with Alice in electrical. You say you left right after Charlie. One of you is lying about who left first. If Charlie left at tick 4 and went to security (Diana confirms seeing him there at tick 6 — that's a 2-tick travel, which fits perfectly), then Charlie's timeline is corroborated by Diana.

Your timeline, Frank, has no corroboration. Nobody saw you in medbay on the way back from electrical except me seeing you LEAVE medbay at tick 7. That's consistent with you killing Alice after Charlie left, then fleeing through medbay to storage to establish an alibi.

I'm leaning Frank. Charlie's story is backed by Diana; Frank's isn't backed by anyone.

I already spoke earlier, but since I'm up again I'll share my read on what's developed.

The key conflict is Charlie vs Frank — both agree they were in electrical with Alice around ticks 3-4, but they disagree on who left last. Charlie's timeline has corroboration: Diana saw him in security at tick 6, and electrical to security is a 2-tick trip, which fits him leaving at tick 4 perfectly.

Frank's timeline (electrical -> medbay -> storage) has a problem. Eve was in medbay and only saw Frank LEAVING medbay toward storage at tick 7. If Frank had come back from electrical through medbay earlier, Eve should have seen him arrive. The simpler explanation is Frank stayed in electrical longer, killed Alice after Charlie left, then passed through medbay to storage — which is exactly when Eve spotted him leaving.

I don't fully rule out Eve since she found the body, but Charlie's alibi via Diana is solid, and Frank's account doesn't reconcile with Eve's medbay sighting. I'm leaning Frank. Curious what Charlie adds, but unless someone produces a real reason to doubt Diana's sighting of Charlie, Frank is my vote.

I'll keep this brief since I already shared my route earlier and a lot has come out since.

To confirm what others have referenced: I saw Charlie enter security from electrical at tick 6. Electrical to security is a 2-tick trip, so that means Charlie left electrical at tick 4 — exactly when he says he did. His alibi checks out on my end.

That leaves Frank's timeline as the weak link. He claims he went electrical -> medbay -> storage, but Eve was in medbay and only saw him leaving toward storage at tick 7, not arriving from electrical. The cleaner explanation is that Frank stayed in electrical with Alice after Charlie left, killed her, then moved through medbay to storage — which is exactly what Eve witnessed.

I'm voting Frank.

Everything Bob, Eve, and Diana just laid out matches my read. My timeline is corroborated by Diana — I left electrical at tick 4 and arrived in security at tick 6, which is the exact 2-tick travel. Frank's timeline isn't corroborated by anyone; Eve only saw him leaving medbay at tick 7, not arriving from electrical earlier.

The cleanest reconstruction: Frank stayed in electrical with Alice after I left at tick 4, killed her, then moved through medbay to storage — which is exactly when Eve caught him heading out of medbay at tick 7. That timing fits a kill window of tick 5-6 perfectly.

I'm voting Frank.

Look, I hear where everyone's landing, but I want to push back one more time because the medbay logic is being misread.

Eve, you said you were in medbay before going to electrical and only saw me LEAVING toward storage at tick 7. But think about what that actually means: medbay is a transit room. If you arrived in medbay AFTER I had already come back from electrical and was about to leave for storage, you'd see exactly what you saw — me heading out. You wouldn't have seen me "arrive" because you weren't there yet. Your own claim is that you went storage -> medbay -> electrical, so you got to medbay sometime around tick 6-7. That's perfectly consistent with me having already passed through.

And here's the thing nobody's addressing: Eve, your route ends with you "finding" Alice in electrical immediately after I supposedly left. If I killed at tick 5-6 and walked to medbay then storage, you'd have walked into an empty electrical with a fresh body — and reported instantly to pin it on the last known person there. That's a textbook reporter-killer play.

But I can read the room. Four of you are locked on me, and I can't prove a negative. If I'm wrong about Eve, you'll see it next round when bodies keep dropping. If I'm right, you'll know tomorrow.

I still vote Eve.
